Resources

I love collecting links, so I've synthesized (haha) a list of various UTAU resources. Everything listed below is 100% free, and a lot of these are open source.

Some links are only available in Japanese and will be marked with (JP).

  • OpenUTAU
    • OpenUTAU Wiki
    • OpenUTAU Mobile
  • Utalet
  • UTAU

Recording

  • OREMO (JP)
    • English language versions of OREMO exist, but this only gives the Japanese version.
  • RecStar

Configuration

  • Laberu
  • setParam
  • vLabeler

Audio Postprocessing

  • Audacity
  • Praat
    • Equalize intensity of all sounds in a folder
